packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds
09a5bfc9a96c4235628ce800db3b95bf28ef2f23	2026-09-03T20:55:31+08:00	packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds

diff --git a/packaging/pcre.spec b/packaging/pcre.spec
index a2b6d92..59f9b04 100644
--- a/packaging/pcre.spec
+++ b/packaging/pcre.spec
@@ -1,4 +1,10 @@
 %define keepstatic 1
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+
 Name:           pcre
 Version:        8.45
 Release:        0
@@ -13,6 +19,10 @@ Source1001: 	pcre.manifest
 BuildRequires:  gcc-c++
 BuildRequires:  libtool
 BuildRequires:  pkg-config
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires:  libc++-devel
+BuildRequires:  libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 %description
 The PCRE library is a set of functions that implement regular
@@ -25,7 +35,11 @@ Group:          System/Libraries
 Requires:       libpcre = %{version}
 Requires:       libpcrecpp = %{version}
 Requires:       libpcreposix = %{version}
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+Requires:       libc++-devel
+%else
 Requires:       libstdc++-devel
+%endif
 
 %description devel
 The PCRE library is a set of functions that implement regular
@@ -98,6 +112,10 @@ cp %{SOURCE1001} .
 
 %build
 export CFLAGS="${CFLAGS} -fPIC"
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
+export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
+%endif
 
 # Available JIT archs see sljit/sljitConfig.h
 autoreconf -fiv
@@ -172,4 +190,3 @@ rm -f %{buildroot}%{_libdir}/*.la
 %license LICENCE
 %manifest %{name}.manifest
 %{_libdir}/*.a
-

    packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds
    
    Use libc++ only when the Base Toolchain selector resolves to Clang.
    Keep GCC and non-toolchain builds on their existing standard library.
